_readme: Classifies each skill's deferred content (reference(s)/scripts/assets) for skill_budget_audit.py's Typical Call estimate. 'deferred-alternatives' = a menu of mutually-exclusive options where a normal call loads roughly one (Typical Call = largest single deferred file). 'deferred-full-use' = cumulative/sequential content that normally all loads together, e.g. a build-script checklist (Typical Call = Worst Case). Skills not listed here default to deferred-full-use until reviewed -- add an entry with a reason to reclassify.

sounding-board.reason: Each references/*.md is a distinct audience persona; a prompt typically engages one audience, occasionally a few more for an explicit 'panel' request, but never realistically all seven at once.

signatry-icons.reason: assets/icons/svg/ is a 69-file library searched via scripts/find_icons.py; a normal task needs one or a small handful of icons, not the whole set.

signatry-facts.reason: reference/*.md files are topic-gated (fees, figures, history, stories, products, assets, named-things); most content tasks need one or two topics, not all seven.

signatry-brand-core.reason: Logo files are use-case-specific (light vs. dark background, full wordmark vs. quill-only) -- a build needs the one matching its context, not all of them; reference/tints.md is loaded only when a specific tint value is actually needed.

signatry-style.reason: Both reference files are narrow-trigger (scripture citation, extended donor narrative) -- most pieces need zero or one, not both.

signatry-photo-library.reason: references/placement-rules.md is only needed when actually placing an image, not when searching or shortlisting -- a search-only task doesn't load it at all.

signatry-resource-library.reason: reference/maintenance.md documents a scheduled maintenance cycle explicitly described as not part of ordinary use -- a normal donor-resource lookup doesn't load it.

signatry-pptx-brand.reason: scripts/ are sequential steps in this skill's own 'Definition of done' checklist and run on every build; the bundled logo assets and design-system.md are required reading/assets for any deck, not just some.

contact-research.reason: scripts/ and references/ are sequential pipeline steps (init -> pull -> derive -> research -> merge -> render) that all run in a normal complete run, not a menu of alternatives. Two branch points exist -- hubspot_pull.py vs. references/hubspot_extraction.md for the API/connector HubSpot pull, and batch.py+playwright_fetch.py vs. api_batch_runner.py+references/research_prompt.md for interactive vs. unattended research -- but each still touches most of the deferred set, so full-use is the more honest default than alternatives.

acos-aboutme.reason: Two reference files that are never both loaded. references/profile.example.json is copied once at enrollment; references/defaults.json is read by consuming skills through their own relative path, not by this skill. scripts/state_backup.py is executed from a shell, never read into context.

acos-calendar-analysis.reason: The only deferred file is scripts/calendar_report.py, which Claude runs via Bash and never reads into context. Worst Case and Typical Call are identical for a single-file skill; this entry records that the file is executed rather than read.

acos-email-sort.reason: All four deferred files are consumed by scripts/triage.py, not by Claude. The script is executed; references/defaults.json, config.example.json and rejection_templates.yaml are opened by that script at runtime. A normal sort run reads none of them into context, so charging the full 91 KB to a typical call overstates it substantially.

acos-jira-analysis.reason: The only deferred file is scripts/jira_report.py, executed via Bash and never read into context. Same single-file situation as acos-calendar-analysis.

acos-main.reason: A run loads exactly one of the two deferred files. references/visual_system.md is read into context before authoring any artifact, as SKILL.md requires; scripts/main_plan.py is executed and never read. They are never both in context, so Typical Call should be one file rather than their sum.

signatry-pdf-brand.reason: Deferred content is one helper script plus font and logo binaries. reportlab opens the fonts and logos from disk and Claude executes the script; none of it is read into context. A typical call loads at most the script.
